newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Chung Won says settles debt repayments.
newsitem.headline: Chung Won says settles debt repayments.

text.p: South Korean textile maker Chung Won Corp, which had failed to pay back notes called in on Monday, said it had settled the repayments by the final deadline, set for the bank close of business on Tuesday.
A company official said the promissory notes were worth 800 billion won, compared with 500-600 million won earlier estimated by an official at the Commercial Bank of Korea.
The Commercial Bank is Chung Won's prime creditor bank.
"All our operations are now going on normally," said the Chung Won official, who declined to be identified.
The news sent Chung Won shares down 550 won to their daily limit of 6,330 won early on Tuesday before the Korea Stock Exchange suspended trading in the company's shares.
